items.question: excel tabular data
items.answer:
To tabulate data in Excel quickly, you can use the **Format as Table** shortcut (`Ctrl + T` ), build a **PivotTable** for summaries, or apply **Count/Sum formulas** for survey results.[[1]](https://www.exceldemy.com/tabulate-data-in-excel/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/W-RrNHX3nm4)[[3]](https://graphed.com/blog/how-to-tabulate-data-in-excel)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SFakdJQNEDA)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rU_Vemb9tGw)

For tips on how to get the summary table setup just right:

![Related video thumbnail](https://api.dataforseo.com/llm_m/cdn/i/4603441988586690865:8ec493a5c6b3206de7fb992ae1394675)
58s
[How to Create a Summary Table in Excel 84K views  · 3 years ago![](https://api.dataforseo.com/llm_m/cdn/i/4603441988586690865:94c9951244f18c2f6526a5e1ee528e69)
YouTube · Chester Tugwell](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SFakdJQNEDA&t=239) 

Basic Table Formatting

- Click any single cell inside your data range.
- Press **Ctrl + T** (or **Cmd + T** on Mac).
- Check the box for **"My table has headers"** if your data has titles.
- Click **OK** to apply default filters and styling.[](https://graphed.com/blog/how-to-tabulate-data-in-excel) [[1]](https://graphed.com/blog/how-to-tabulate-data-in-excel)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M07df44RXOM)

Summary Tabulation (PivotTables)

- Select a cell inside your data table.
- Go to the **Insert** tab on the top ribbon and click **PivotTable**.
- Choose **New Worksheet** or **Existing Worksheet** , then click **OK**.
- Drag and drop fields into **Rows**, **Columns** , and **Values** (set values to "Count" or "Sum" as needed) to tabulate frequencies.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJWNucbLHs8) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJWNucbLHs8)[[2]](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/get-started/create-a-pivottable-to-analyze-worksheet-data)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=saS7N8HzTuU&t=2)

If you'd like more specific help, let me know:

- What **kind of data** are you trying to tabulate (e.g., survey results, financial transactions, inventory)?
- Do you need a **simple list** , a **frequency count** , or a **cross-tabulation**?

items.question: instagram ad interest
items.answer:
Instagram ad interests are `behavioral targeting options accessed via Meta Ads Manager under "Detailed Targeting"` . They let you show ads to users based on pages they follow, posts they like or save, and content they engage with across Instagram and Facebook.[](https://coinis.com/how-to/use-interest-targeting-instagram-ads) [[1]](https://coinis.com/how-to/use-interest-targeting-instagram-ads)[[2]](https://elyspace.com/blog/instagram-ad-interests-list/)[[3]](https://graphed.com/blog/how-to-choose-interests-for-instagram-ad)[[4]](https://pixelscan.net/blog/instagram-ad-interests-a-step-by-step-guid/)How Interest Targeting Works

- **Behavior-Based:** Meta compiles data from real-time user actions like clicks, comments, and video views rather than self-reported profile data.[](https://elyspace.com/blog/instagram-ad-interests-list/) 
- **Shared Infrastructure:** Because Instagram runs on Meta's system, interest categories are identical to those used on Facebook.[](https://coinis.com/how-to/use-interest-targeting-instagram-ads) 
- **Audience Size:** Options range from broad umbrella topics (like "Fitness and wellness") down to niche micro-communities (like "Marathon running").[](https://www.prosemedia.com/blog/using-instagram-ads-to-target-micro-communities-with-niche-interests-for-maximum-engagement) [[1]](https://www.prosemedia.com/blog/using-instagram-ads-to-target-micro-communities-with-niche-interests-for-maximum-engagement)

Best Practices for Campaigns

- **Audience Scale:** Aim for a target audience size of at least 2 million people when grouping related interests.[](https://coinis.com/how-to/best-way-to-use-interest-targeting-instagram-ads) [[1]](https://coinis.com/how-to/best-way-to-use-interest-targeting-instagram-ads)
- **Ad Set Separation:** Test 3 to 5 related interests per ad set, and split unrelated categories into separate ad sets to track performance data clearly.[](https://coinis.com/how-to/use-interest-targeting-instagram-ads) 
- **Creative as Targeting:** Modern Meta updates mean the algorithm often uses your ad's video hook, headline, and visual context to find interested sub-audiences within your parameters.
